limitations: The expression gives target-by-target exact counts, not an unconditional simple histogram for arbitrary abelian complements. The known zero-commutator count is credited to Erovenko and Sury (2008); the extension to all targets and cyclic prime-index uniformity are the assessed claims. A related 2015 full text could not be inspected.
title: Complete prescribed-commutator fibers in finite abelian regular wreath products
